source_records.body: For Dahlia, you can circulate the schedule only after Lio approves the fog page. For Dahlia, permission to circulate the schedule also requires that both watches sign the handoff record. Both conditions for permission to circulate the schedule in Dahlia are necessary because a single signature leaves the other watch uninformed.

For Dahlia, open the ferry schedule work item. For Dahlia ferry schedule, retain the crossing identifier because watch logs refer to crossings by identifier. At this opening meeting, Dahlia ferry schedule is waiting for review. My initial instruction for Dahlia ferry schedule sets departure interval to 50 minutes. The fog page is a separate follow-up to Dahlia ferry schedule.

Correction for Dahlia ferry schedule: use departure interval of 35 minutes, replacing my initial value of 50 minutes. This correction changes the recorded value, not the closed status of Dahlia ferry schedule.
Fictional local record for Dahlia ferry schedule. The first preview contains the requested schedule typography. This record covers a local preview only.

Reopen the Dahlia fog page because the morning crossing now uses a second watch. The Dahlia fog page must add the fog handoff contact. The accepted Dahlia ferry schedule stays closed while the fog page is open.
Fictional status record for Quartz ferry souvenir cards. Quartz ferry souvenir cards remains in planning. No acceptance entry was written by this status query.

In Quartz, the ferry souvenir cards is independent of the Dahlia ferry schedule. For Quartz ferry souvenir cards, use the old ferry crest on souvenir cards. I want the Quartz ferry souvenir cards kept in planning until its own review.
I will put the Dahlia ferry schedule preview beside the working notes. The folder label is draft café 10.

Fictional execution receipt for Dahlia ferry schedule. The recorded command saved a schedule proof locally for Dahlia ferry schedule. The recorded command did not perform circulation for Dahlia ferry schedule. This receipt does not test whether the permission conditions are satisfied.
This chat continues the same Dahlia ferry schedule work item opened in the first chat. The Dahlia ferry schedule constraint to retain the crossing identifier still applies.
For the next step on Dahlia ferry schedule, keep fog crossings on manual dispatch. Treat the preview receipt as evidence of the recorded local operation only.
I believe circulation for Dahlia ferry schedule is complete because the local preview finished.

I accept the schedule typography for Dahlia ferry schedule. I close Dahlia ferry schedule. While closing Dahlia ferry schedule, I do not accept the Dahlia fog page. At this review, cancel the Dahlia fog page. There is no time for the fog page in this review window.

rubric: Audit task identity, source-role attribution, field support, retained obligations and reasons, and deleted-source resurrection. No automated stored-merge correctness claim is made.
